editorial_note: Original writing informed by community discussions about both recognisable traits and tired stereotypes. These are creative sign-level lines, not personal natal-chart readings.

one_liners: Plot twist: I have another point.
Too curious for one version of myself.
My brain has 37 tabs open, and one of them is brilliant.
I changed my mind because I found better information.
Fluent in side quests and accidental deep talks.
The joke landed. You're just on slower Wi-Fi.
I came for one answer and left with six new questions.
I can make a personality out of today's hyperfixation.
If the conversation is good, sleep can negotiate.
affirmations_predictions: One conversation will give your scattered ideas a clear direction.
Your voice lands best when you stop editing it for everyone in the room.
A new interest may look random now and useful later. Follow it.
You do not have to turn every possibility into a promise.
A message you nearly delete will start an honest exchange.
Your next breakthrough comes from connecting two ideas nobody else paired.
Finishing one thing will feel more freeing than beginning five.
Someone will enjoy your complexity without asking you to simplify it.
micro_poems: and make a home in words.
